Metadata.Title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled
Metadata.Name: Online: 30 network updates per second
Metadata.Note: The game sends this PC's race state to the other players when a timer passes 1/15 s and then resets the timer to 0, so at 60 FPS a send waits 4 or 5 frames: 13.3 updates a second, and weapon events wait for the next one. This sends when the timer passes 25 ms: every 2 frames at 60 FPS, 30 a second. It changes only what this PC sends, so it works even if others don't use it; the more players use it, the better.
Metadata.Author: haglazpl (OCTR-NitroFueled-PC fork)

Metadata.Title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled
Metadata.Name: Online: other karts shown 67 ms behind (needs 30 updates for everyone)
Metadata.Note: The game shows the other players as they were 133 ms ago (on top of the ping), so that it always has the next update to slide them towards: two updates at the game's original 15 a second. This makes it 67 ms: two updates at 30 a second, so the karts and weapons you see are 67 ms closer to where they really are. Use it only when everyone in the room has the 30 network updates patch on: a player sending 15 a second would move in jerks.
Metadata.Author: haglazpl (OCTR-NitroFueled-PC fork)

Metadata.Title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled
Metadata.Name: Online (experiment): other karts shown 33 ms behind
Metadata.Note: Test only, instead of the 67 ms patch (turn that one off). Shows the other players one update (33 ms at 30 a second) in the past instead of two: they are closer to where they really are, but a late update can make them stutter or be guessed forward. Needs the 30 network updates patch for everyone.
Metadata.Author: haglazpl (OCTR-NitroFueled-PC fork)

Metadata.Title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled
Metadata.Name: Online (experiment): other karts shown with no delay
Metadata.Note: Test only, instead of the 67 ms patch (turn that one off). The game shows the other players at the current moment, so it has to guess their position from their last update (its own prediction), or holds them at their last update if it does not guess. Closest to where they really are, but expect jerky or jumping karts. Needs the 30 network updates patch for everyone.
Metadata.Author: haglazpl (OCTR-NitroFueled-PC fork)

Metadata.Title: Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled
Metadata.Name: Online: each PC decides potion hits only for its own kart
Metadata.Note: The game lets every PC decide, from where the karts are on its own screen, that another player's kart drove into a potion; the other players then see the potion hit (or vanish) although on their screen the kart was not in it. With this on, this PC decides potion hits only for the kart you drive (and, for the host, the AI karts); a potion another player drives into is decided by that player's PC. It changes only what this PC decides, so it works in a room where others don't use it; it is complete when everyone uses it. Needs build net14 or later.
Metadata.Author: haglazpl (OCTR-NitroFueled-PC fork)
